primaryGoal: Track week-over-week changes in six key opportunity KPIs (M1, S0, S1 ACV and Count) on a cumulative quarterly basis to assess performance trends toward targets for the current quarter.
assumptions: The date columns (Opportunity M1 Date, Opportunity S0 Date, Opportunity S1 Date) accurately reflect when opportunities reached their respective stages.
The current quarter is defined by the system's fiscal calendar and 'This Quarter' filter will correctly identify it.
Weekly aggregation starts from the beginning of the current quarter and each week represents a complete 7-day period.
The mandatory filters (Opportunity Type IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer') AND Opportunity Deployment != 'mode') apply uniformly to all opportunities across all stages.
Previous week refers to the most recently completed full week, and this week refers to the current ongoing or just-completed week.
Cumulative sum calculations restart at the beginning of each quarter as specified by the quarter_number function.

phases.phaseTitle: M1 Stage KPI Tracking - ACV Performance
phases.phaseDescription: Establish baseline and week-over-week trend for M1 Starting ACV by calculating cumulative quarterly values on a weekly basis, then computing the change from previous week to current week.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1.1: M1 ACV Cumulative Weekly Data for Current Quarter
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve the cumulative sum of M1 Starting ACV by week for the current quarter to enable week-over-week comparison.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity M1 Date] (aggregated weekly), cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] = 'This Quarter', Weekly aggregation, [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Calculate the cumulative sum of [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV] by [Opportunity M1 Date], restarting for each quarter using the formula cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Apply filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] = 'This Quarter', aggregate by week, [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), and [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'. Include columns: week of [Opportunity M1 Date] and the cumulative ACV value.
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: M1 Stage KPI Tracking - ACV Performance

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1.1.1: Calculate M1 ACV for Previous Week and Current Week
analysisSteps.aggregation: Cumulative sum of [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV] (already calculated in fetch)
analysisSteps.question: What is the cumulative M1 Starting ACV as of the end of the previous week and as of the end of the current week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched cumulative weekly M1 ACV data, identify the two most recent weeks. Label the earlier one as 'Previous Week' and the later one as 'Current Week'. Extract the cumulative ACV value for each. Report: 'M1 ACV Previous Week: [value]' and 'M1 ACV Current Week: [value]'.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 Stage KPI Tracking - ACV Performance

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1.1.2: Compute M1 ACV Week-over-Week Change and Percentage Change
analysisSteps.aggregation: Difference and percentage change between two cumulative values
analysisSteps.question: What is the absolute change and percentage change in M1 Starting ACV from the previous week to the current week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the M1 ACV values from the previous week and current week identified in the prior analysis, calculate: Change = Current Week ACV - Previous Week ACV. Calculate Percentage Change = (Change / Previous Week ACV) * 100. Report: 'M1 ACV Change: [value]' and 'M1 ACV Percentage Change: [value]%'. Provide interpretation: Is the trend positive (increasing) or negative (decreasing)?
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: M1 Stage KPI Tracking - ACV Performance
